traits.label: Cheap
traits.description: Roll a D6 after any combat encounter, or as fiction might dictate. A roll of 1 and it breaks.

traits.label: Armor Piercing (AP)
traits.description: Ignore all armor (damage rolls of 1 misfire)

traits.label: Exploding
traits.description: Re-roll max damage dice and add to total.

traits.label: Spec Ammo
traits.description: Special ammo, charge, or fuel. Max damage rolls require spending a turn reloading/refueling and consume a unit of spec ammo from your inventory.

traits.label: Overclocked
traits.description: On max damage, upgrade dice type. 6>8>10. 10 on a d10 will reset the weapon to its base dice and the weapon will need 2d6 hours to recharge. Can manually re-set the battery outside of combat for 1d6 hours recharge.

traits.label: Parry
traits.description: Melee attacks of 2 damage or less are harmlessly parried away.

traits.label: Grapple
traits.description: Entangle your opponent. They will need to pass a STR Save to break free.

traits.label: Sweep
traits.description: Long weapons that allow a second attack on an adjacent opponent.

traits.label: Brutal
traits.description: Big enough to instantly kill an opponent on max damage and force a morale check on the target’s allies.

traits.label: Vorpal
traits.description: Damage immediately bypasses HP, going straight to STR and requiring a save against Critical Damage. Typically illegal.

traits.label: Deadly
traits.description: Deadly weapons are fast enough to roll again on max damage and add to total.

traits.label: Thermal
traits.description: DEX Save or take 1D4 heat damage for 1D4 rounds.

traits.label: Cryo
traits.description: STR Save or do half damage on next attack.

traits.label: Shock
traits.description: DEX Save or lose turn for 1 round.

traits.label: EMP
traits.description: STR save or lose turn for 1 round.

traits.label: Biological
traits.description: STR save or 1D4 damage for 1D4 rounds.

traits.label: Serrating
traits.description: STR Save or 1D4 damage for 1D4 rounds.

traits.label: Sonic
traits.description: WIL Save or lose turn for 1 round.

traits.label: Disintegration
traits.description: DEX Save vs instant obliteration. Usually illegal.

traits.label: Bulky
traits.description: Takes up two slots, and is typically two-handed or awkward to carry.

traits.label: Blast
traits.description: Affects every target in the noted area, rolling separately for each.
